source_handling.permission: Nexus author requires permission before reusing assets in another mod

human_steps: Install Surveyor 0.3.52 using Check app update > Install update.
Start NMS once, then fully close it so the NMS MODS path is recorded.
Download the mod ZIP for personal use.
Click Install Derelict Farming archive and select the ZIP.
Fully restart NMS; use an emergency scanner, pulse within 10 seconds, finish the derelict, then repeat in the same system.
rollback: Run python tools/github_integration.py rollback-derelict-farming from the Surveyor project folder.
